opinions.text: D. C. E. D. Wash. [Probable jurisdiction postponed, 440 U. S. 905.] Motion of the Solicitor General for additional time for oral argument granted, and 15 additional minutes allotted to the appellees. Appellants also allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
